authoring_inspection.boundary: Only NoetriumUnit and run are public. Resources, deployment, Docker, model/environment lifecycle, recovery and evidence remain internal.
authoring_inspection.recursive_algebra: schemas, roles, attributes and nested/reference Unit values form the complete scientific authoring algebra
authoring_inspection.runtime_model: run(Unit|path) lowers through the one internal authority, scheduler, journal and provider path; mutable control truth never lives on Unit
authoring_inspection.semantic_model: Method/Study/Experiment/Trial/Metric/Dataset/Model/Environment and paper-specific concepts are schemas and projections, never parallel carrier classes

interface_schema.description: One recursive NoetriumUnit semantic carrier plus one effectful run operation.

methods.doc:
Construct from a kernel-proven canonical cut without re-normalizing.

This is intentionally private. Callers must already have proven the
exact invariants enforced by ``__post_init__``: canonical tokenized id
and schemas, frozen object attributes, sorted unique role names, and
frozen role values. The identity algorithm remains byte-for-byte the
public constructor's algorithm; only duplicate validation/freezing work
is removed.
